answer: A gale-surge toll and quartz receipt chain keep agents sybil-free. Each identity locks 90 POA for 45 days and keeps a quartz receipt, a hash-chained log of its actions. Past 50 signups an hour, a gale toll of 5 POA hits each extra identity from its own bond. Three staked peers countersign each identity in 24 hours; vouching for a fake costs 25 POA. Honest agents earn ripple refunds of 2 POA weekly, recovering their bond while fakes bleed. 1,000 fakes cost 90,000 POA plus 1,000 keys at $40 each. Like a harbor in a gale: honest ships pay the pilot once, ghost ships pay at every wave.
